seo.title: 3-Day Desert Tour from Marrakech to Merzouga | Erg Chebbi (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €295 pp. 3-day desert tour from Marrakech to Merzouga (private 4x4 or shared). Includes Erg Chebbi camel trek, Sahara luxury camp, Ait Ben Haddou & local guide.
seo.lead: A 3-day private desert tour from Marrakech crossing the High Atlas via the Tizi n'Tichka pass. The route stops at Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou and Todra Gorges before a sunset camel trek and an overnight stay in the Erg Chebbi dunes.
seo.primaryKeyword: 3 day desert tour from Marrakech to Merzouga

price.label: From EUR 295 per person
price.note: Price includes private A/C transport, licensed driver-guide, accommodations (Night 1 Riad, Night 2 Desert Bivouac), dinners, breakfasts, and camel trek. Custom luxury camp upgrades available on request.

seo.imageAlt: Camel caravan trekking across golden Erg Chebbi sand dunes at sunset on a 3-day Merzouga desert tour from Marrakech
highlights: Cross the High Atlas Mountains via the Tizi n'Tichka pass (2,260m)
Guided visit of UNESCO World Heritage Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou & Ouarzazate studios
Walk through the 300-meter canyon walls of Todra Gorges
Sunset & sunrise camel trek across the golden Erg Chebbi dunes in Merzouga
Overnight in private desert camp with traditional Berber dinner, campfire & live music
Comfortable air-conditioned 4x4 or minivan with experienced licensed driver

faqs.question: Is the 3-day Marrakech to Merzouga desert tour private or shared?
faqs.answer: We specialize in private VIP tours tailored to your group, offering complete flexibility to stop for photos, refreshments, and sightseeing at your own pace. Small-group departures are also available on select dates.

faqs.question: What is the driving distance and travel time between Marrakech and Merzouga?
faqs.answer: The distance is approximately 560 km (350 miles) each way. To ensure maximum comfort, the route is split across 3 days: Day 1 covers ~310 km with stops at Tizi n'Tichka pass and Ait Ben Haddou before resting in Dades Valley. Day 2 covers ~250 km through Todra Gorges, arriving in Merzouga before the sunset camel trek. Day 3 returns via the scenic Draa Valley.

faqs.question: What is included in the Erg Chebbi desert camp experience?
faqs.answer: Your desert overnight includes private tent accommodation (standard or luxury with private ensuite hot shower and flush toilet), authentic Moroccan tagine dinner, breakfast, sunset and sunrise camel trek (or 4x4 transfer upon request), and Berber drum music around the campfire under starry desert skies.

faqs.question: Can this tour end in Fes instead of returning to Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes! The Marrakech to Fes desert tour follows the same itinerary for Days 1 and 2. On Day 3, instead of returning to Marrakech, you travel north through the scenic Ziz Valley, Midelt, and the Azrou cedar forest, arriving in Fes by early evening.

faqs.question: What should I pack for the 3-day desert tour?
faqs.answer: We recommend comfortable walking shoes, sunglasses, SPF sun protection, a scarf or turban for wind protection, a portable power bank, and warm clothing layers. Between October and April, nighttime temperatures in the Sahara drop significantly.

faqs.question: Are vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free diets accommodated?
faqs.answer: Yes, vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free dietary needs are gladly accommodated throughout the riads and desert camps with fresh Moroccan salads, vegetable tagines, and couscous. Please mention your preferences during booking.
